notes.title: Bug Fixes #11
notes.content:
- Execute did not work after death and revival bug
- upgrades menu issues that occurred sometimes
- some side quests were not offering rewards for completing them
- side quest Dwarf in Mountain Rok stage was giving Dwarf Gold too often
- going back to Odin's altar used to restart an older quest 
- Jotunheim stairs colliders fixed
- Dwarfheim improved colliders
- Viking great hall has better colliders 
- better floor collider in Jotunheim 
- better floor collider in Fafnir's Layer 
- balanced AI
- some VFX were optimized
- some objects were optimized
- some UI fixes

notes.title: Bug Fixes #10
notes.content:
Shield Outlaw Boss will not start attacking until the first dialogue is finished
	Bandit Boss will not start attacking until the first dialogue is finished
	ctrl menu + death used to get the player stuck for some people
	some quests were resetting due to teleporting needing more time for saving data on certain devices
	at endgame the quest in the Viking Village was resetting
	improved some colliders in stages 8 and 9
	improved AI paths in some stages

notes.title: Bug Fixes #8
notes.content:
ambient music added
saving is now done on a longer period to reduce the risk of issues occurring with the save files
improved colliders in some areas
other minor fixes

notes.title: Viking Vengeance launches on April 8!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075722/b593696baa7c21c9d257adc76ecc6fa28ddaa830.png[/img]
[b][h1]Viking Vengeance launches April 8, 2021.[/h1][/b]
[b]The Vikings are coming! [/b]Please share the news with the world! Thanks everyone for being supportive and providing great feedback, [b]you are our fuel! [/b]

1.0 won’t be the end for Viking Vengeance, we’re committed to make it a long-term game with regular updates and additions, including features, Acts, gameplay content, playable characters and items.

Check out the new trailer! 

Thanks again everyone!

notes.title: Awesome 1st Week of Kickstarter and Steam Page Update
notes.content:
[b]Black Friday Special Reward[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075722/53fe53ff9eb592c6884eee9d41e7aa0aeda93c93.gif[/img]
Hi guys! We wanted to thank you for all the support and pledges on our Kickstarter and let you know we are running a 24 hours Black Friday Special Reward and you can Pre-Order the game at a -25% discount. 

[h1][b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vikingvengeance/viking-vengeance]BLACK FRIDAY DISCOUNT -25%[/url][/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075722/91468406cf031b85380ee1b8c0e075b74965359c.gif[/img]


[b]We got Viral on Imgur this week![/b]
A deep thank you for sharing, for the updates and all the love you gave us these days! We got Viral thanks to you and we appreciate the opportunity! We thought we'd share some of the reactions that made our day and push us on our long road to delivering you a great game. [url=https://imgur.com/gallery/yKOdm5R]Link to Viral Post![/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075722/3ed38369438c89146a4c73d3d3ce99c527f7abc4.png[/img]


[b]Some awesome reactions on YT and TW![/b]
We were thrilled to see people playing our game online and enjoy their experience with our pre-alpha demo. This was the first time we made our demo public so we were quite nervous but in the end people were very nice and encouraged us and our progress, helped a lot with bug finding and great constructive feedback.
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vikingvengeance/viking-vengeance/posts/2696002]More here.[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075722/8db92316f74e7d4d775e35adf295b6266db20930.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075722/e7990ef5935a08edb5d8eba7f20ec9466089247e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075722/6b8883d39994e82212b7f6c43eae6988a9018a72.gif[/img]


[b]Bonus Devplay Booth Testings[/b]
We were honored and happy to see people testing our game at the dev.play event in Bucharest, offer their feedback and support. It was a great experience that opened our eyes to how other people will try to play the game, what problems they encounter and how the entire experience feels to them.
